tools.name: get_scan_analytics
tools.description: Free. Returns how many times a QR code was scanned, in total and per UTC day. Needs no API key: the counts for a code can be read by anyone with its ID. tools.description: Free. Signed in (OAuth) or with an API key, returns whether that account has Pro, the subscription status and when the current period ends. Otherwise, returns what the free and Pro plans include and the Pro price ($9/month).
